scope: synthetic controlled development only; not a real application claim

generator.name: balanced_contextual_sbm_bernoulli_pairs_v1
generator.noise: independent standard normal; no normalization fitted on held-out data
generator.sampling: each unordered pair sampled once, no edge deletion, no self loops before propagation
generator.membership: balanced predefined synthetic client/class blocks; not a label-informed partition of real data

seeds.derivation: numpy SeedSequence([whole_graph_seed, stream_id]).generate_state(1)[0]; training uses SeedSequence([model_seed, round, client_id])
seeds.pairing: same seed shares features, splits, client membership and model seed across grid cells; independent whole-graph seeds are the experimental units

identity.operator: identity in training AND every completion; structurally graph invariant

strong_mlp.capacity_rule: nearest integer hidden width to 8775 parameters, selected by counts only; 0.9345% larger; residual GELU + LayerNorm, no architecture search

training.optimizer: Adam reset for each client in each round, inherited train_client
training.aggregation: FedAvg weighted by local labelled training count
training.loss: P/I: CE(feature)+CE(spectral), MLP: CE(output); no certificate loss
training.checkpoint: each model maximizes its own pooled validation Macro-F1, exact ties earliest round; no certificate or full-graph selection
training.pairing: P/I identical initial state and per-client/per-round random seeds, train masks, capacity and budgets; MLP same seed and optimizer budget, different parameter-matched architecture
training.dtype: float32 training; CPU float64 frozen-checkpoint certificate and diagnostic audit
training.resource_failure: stop and preserve failure; no hidden CPU retry, seed replacement, model or budget reduction

certification.ledger: exact generated cross-client incident counts consumed as safe upper bounds
certification.primary_comparison: cone_hybrid minus retained_pairwise on identical observed-P checkpoint/logits
certification.exposure: boundary rows plus K-2 observed local hops, computed independently of labels and shared by P/I/MLP
certification.acceptance: worst_slack > 1e-6 for each numerical certificate; hybrid is the union; not a formally rounded floating-point proof
certification.invariant_controls: I/MLP have coverage 1 by their predictor definitions, including ties; not credited as new completion certificates

diagnostic.completion: the single generated full graph, legal under the upper-count ledger, same frozen model and fixed features
diagnostic.scope: validation nodes only; full propagation may use unlabelled features transductively
diagnostic.bounds: per-order hidden displacement, symmetric class-logit bounds and cone class-pair lower bounds
diagnostic.interpretation: one completion is a sensitivity witness, never exhaustive verification; zero empirical violations do not prove soundness

hard_stop: any analytic bound violation beyond tolerance
stopping.decision: all 24 runs finish before efficacy inspection; arithmetic seed means within each of four cells; at least one cell meets every gate => eligible_for_separately_authorized_confirmation, otherwise stop_after_e28b_development; all seeds/cells retained
stopping.inference: two development seeds: point estimates only, no inferential CI or significance claims, no revising h/rho/feature signal/alpha after efficacy inspection
stopping.confirmation: reserved 8 seeds x full 12-cell grid x 3 controls = 288 runs; needs separate user authorization and pre-execution confirmation analysis freeze; no confirmation seed generated by this runner

artifacts.freeze: exclusive freeze_manifest.json with protocol/code/protected-file hashes, seed audit and exact run matrix
artifacts.data: exclusive full graph/features/membership/four-way masks bundle per graph; labels for audit/test sealed from training/evaluation helpers
artifacts.models: initial state tensor digest, selected checkpoint and digest, validation trajectory, validation-only predictions/certificates/diagnostics
artifacts.failure: failure.json retained; no overwrite or replacement
artifacts.old_results: E19-E24 decisions, E28a results, manuscript, core theory code and submission ZIP unchanged
